RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your longer experience is relevant, but it doesn’t establish that you were the strongest candidate against the selection criteria; digital expertise could legitimately matter.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons for choosing the successful candidate.

Raise concerns about sex if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply because of the panel’s composition.

If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for an explanation may not pause them.
